# Avanya

> Avanya is a North Bengal-focused discovery platform for Tourism stays and Real Estate — Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Kurseong, Mirik, Dooars, Lava, and Kaffer. Discovery only: no online bookings or payments; every listing links to a direct enquiry (WhatsApp, call, or email).

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.avanyatourism.example/index.html): Avanya's homepage — an overview of both discovery verticals and all seven North Bengal locations.
- [Tourism](https://www.avanyatourism.example/tourism.html): Browse and filter all published Tourism stays (homestays, resorts, heritage bungalows, tea bungalows, farm stays, hotels) across North Bengal.
- [Real Estate](https://www.avanyatourism.example/real-estate.html): Browse and filter all published Real Estate listings (land, homestays, resorts, bungalows, hotels, flats, houses) available to buy or lease across North Bengal.
- [Search](https://www.avanyatourism.example/search.html): Free-text search across Tourism stays, Real Estate listings, locations, and experience tags.
- [Plan a Custom Trip](https://www.avanyatourism.example/travel-plan.html): Request a hand-picked North Bengal itinerary by submitting travel dates, group size, and interests.
- [About](https://www.avanyatourism.example/about.html): Avanya's story, mission, and the seven North Bengal locations it operates in.
- [Contact](https://www.avanyatourism.example/contact.html): Send Avanya a general enquiry, or reach the team directly by WhatsApp, phone, or email.
- [North Bengal](https://www.avanyatourism.example/north-bengal.html): All seven North Bengal locations Avanya covers, each linking to its Tourism stays and Real Estate listings.
- [Things to Do](https://www.avanyatourism.example/things-to-do.html): Browse North Bengal by experience — mountain views, tea-garden stays, river-front, wildlife/forest, heritage & colonial — each linking to matching Tourism stays.

## Notes

- All 24 published listings (14 Tourism, 10 Real Estate) each have their own static page at /property/<slug>.html — see /sitemap.xml for the full, machine-generated list of every individual listing URL; this file intentionally lists page *categories*, not all 24 listings by name, matching the convention's "table of contents" purpose rather than duplicating the sitemap.
- Listing content (names, descriptions, prices) is illustrative synthetic data for this build, not live Avanya inventory — see README.md.
